title: Rippers Unmasked — Classes & Skills
description: The Rippers Unmasked class corpus as native Foundry Item packs the GM drags onto Project FU sheets: type:class Items for every Rippers class, their class skills as UUID-linked type:skill Items, and heroic skills as type:heroic Items with their requirements listed. Ships a browsable JournalEntry Player Reference pack (all 68 classes + shared-subsystem notes as readable prose). Original campaign content, layered on Project FU. A personal-table module — not for redistribution.

rippers-compendium.note: Items validate against Project FU's class/skill/heroic DataModels (packs system:projectfu). The player-reference JournalEntry pack (v0.3.0) renders the verbatim player binder — 68 classes + shared-subsystem notes — as browsable in-world prose (folders: Innate Only / Guise / Appendix), built from lodge-docs/COMPENDIUM-player-reference.md by tools/build-journals.mjs; formatting-only, no rules edits (editorial ✎/⚠/⛔ glyph marks stripped, all prose incl. house rulings kept). No FU content is redistributed; no automation code.
